scope_and_distinctness.exact_scope: For closed genus g≥5 and r dividing 2g−2, higher-spin stabilizers give finite-index subgroups generated by individual Dehn twists. Their indices and conjugacy classes for fixed r are classified by parity/Arf invariant. This is a complete classification within this natural family, not of all twist-generated finite-index subgroups.
